newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mar maize delivery on S.Africa futures 33 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Mar maize delivery on S.Africa futures 33 mln rand.

text.p: The South African Futures Exchange (Safex) said on Thursday a total of 33 million rand worth of maize was delivered on the market in March, with a final quantity of 47,700 tonnes put through on Thursday.
Safex said in a statement physical maize deliveries were effected through the issue and delivery of Safex silo receipts at silos throughout the maize-producing area.
It said although the primary aim of the futures market, which trades contracts on both white and yellow maize, was to manage price risk it could also be used as a guaranteed forward market.

Safex said South Africa's first official estimate for maize production in 1997, which showed the crop falling to 7.5 million tonnes from initial estimates of 10 million tonnes, illustrated the uncertain situation facing the country's maize industry.
